envelope.description: Add the classified, timed gh runner

body.title: Add the classified, timed gh runner
body.summary: Add runGh and GhCommandError in src/workflow/tracker/github.ts beside the existing exec seam: a 10 s timeout, classification of ENOENT as missing-tool, an authentication failure as missing-signin, a timeout as unreachable and anything else as rejected, all through the same _setTrackerExecForTests seam so tests can pass the timeout option.
acceptanceChecks: runGh classifies ENOENT, an authentication failure, a timeout and any other failure into the four kinds
The fake exec seam receives the 10 s timeout option
out() and silent() used by the retained wrappers are unchanged

tests.name: src/workflow/tracker/__tests__/github-adapter.test.ts: runGh classifies ENOENT, authentication failure, timeout and other failures
src/workflow/tracker/__tests__/github-adapter.test.ts: runGh passes the 10 s timeout option to the exec seam
src/workflow/tracker/__tests__/tracker.test.ts: out and silent keep their current options
